title: AMDGPU XFCE Crashing to login in games
body: As per title, It's been happening for a while and have no idea how to fix it. I thought it was fixed 6 or so months ago but it still does it. In Diablo 2 resurrected and now Hellraiser games it will out of the blue just stop then logout. It seems to be ok in KDE Plasma but not real keen on that.
